body:
For some releases strange naming is used. So many utility like [binup](https://github.com/KonishchevDmitry/binup) can't download ART. I suggest to change. Reference design [here](https://github.com/conan-io/conan/releases).
1. For AppImage you prefer x86_64 but why you use x64 for others? Let's use x86_64 for all?
2. linux64 is weird, use -x64 or -x86_64. I like x86_64 because it is what `uname -m` received, but both is ok
ART-1.26.3-linux64.tar.xz -> ART-1.26.3-linux-x64.tar.xz
1. For windows you should not use several styles: Win64 vs Windows. 
2. Why you use "_" for windows and for macos but "-" for Linux? Use one style like in reference design!
ART_1.26.3_Win64.exe -> ART-1.26.3-windows.exe
ART_1.26.3_Win64_portable.7z -> ART-1.26.3-windows-portable.7z
ART_1.26.3_Windows_arm64.exe -> ART-1.26.3-windows-arm64.exe
ART_1.26.3_Windows_arm64_portable.7z  -> ART-1.26.3-windows-arm64-portable.7z
3. What about archiving exe to zip or 7z like in reference design?
3. ART-1.26.3.tar.xz - what is it? Is it source code? But github automatically add source code to each release: Source code (zip), Source code (tar.gz) - is it not enough? I suggest to drop "ART-1.26.3.tar.xz"
4. I suggest to use macos instead of macOS and "-" instead of "_" like in reference design:
ART-1.26.3_macOS-14.8_arm64.dmg -> ART-1.26.3-macos-14.8_arm64.dmg
ART-1.26.3_macOS-15.7_x64.dmg -> ART-1.26.3-macos-15.7_x64.dmg

This is what binup see for now
